# Muhammad Gulzaib — Complete Portfolio Content

Muhammad Gulzaib is a Senior Full Stack Engineer, AI systems builder and SaaS founder based in Islamabad, Pakistan. He has 5+ years of experience building scalable SaaS platforms and AI-powered web applications, and is the Founder & CEO of SynergyFlow Labs, an AI-focused technology company building agentic AI SaaS, rapid MVP development, ERP systems and custom business software. He is currently seeking remote or relocation opportunities in UAE / KSA.

## Field notes (lessons)

1. Validate before you build — a POS SaaS taught that customers needed offline + online; months of code can't outrun a requirement you never asked about.
2. Distribution beats features — great engineering doesn't sell itself; sales channels, demos and pilots come before the roadmap.
3. Real users, not feature lists — school staff want simple, mobile-first tools they'll actually open every day.
4. Small & profitable wins — a narrow product with paying customers beats a giant vision with none.
